description: 20대 핵심축 기반 비주얼 연속성 및 물리 팩트 검증 사규 (ACCG v2.0)

weather.mandatory_keywords: heavy rain, dripping wet textures, water puddles reflecting neon lights, atmospheric Seoul 1997 midnight
weather.hair_texture: soaked wet black hair clinging to forehead, cheeks and neck, dripping rain droplets glistening under streetlights, authentic drenched rain texture

character_g3_anchor.costume: drenched 90s vintage oversized black belted trench coat over wet satin cocktail dress
character_g3_anchor.features: sleek sharp cat-eye eyeliner, Korean female protagonist, intense cinematic stare

dual_anchor_strategy.description: 얼굴 일관성과 화각/체형 일관성을 동시에 100% 묶기 위한 2중 앵커 참조 기법

required_elements: clock hands frozen at exactly 00:00 midnight
Neura turning head back with sharp alert expression
hiding against wet dark brick alley wall
smartphone held in hand with OLED FRONT SCREEN strictly facing camera/Neura
screen glowing with green 1% battery indicator and red warning frame
matte glass back panel and camera lenses must rest flat against the palm or facing away from screen
subtle neon screen reflection illuminating her wet jawline and eyes
distant silhouettes of hunters holding black umbrellas in blurred rain background
forbidden_errors: battery indicator appearing on the camera/back panel of phone

required_elements: sprinting forward through deep puddles, water splashing violently
soaking wet trench coat billowing behind her in dynamic motion
eyes fiercely locked onto the illuminated green metallic payphone booth ahead
chasing agents in black suits far behind in rainy motion blur
vintage 1997 silver metallic payphone unit mounted clearly on the left wall with coin slot and push-button dial keypad
heavy spiraled steel coil cord extending from the bottom of the payphone unit directly to the handset in Neura's hand
silver handset firmly pressed against right ear
expression of sudden shock, frozen breath, pupils dilated as she hears her own cold voice from the receiver
forbidden_errors: handset floating without payphone unit mounted on wall
missing spiral steel cord connecting unit and receiver
modern digital payphone or smartphone inside booth
